summary: Studio City Company announced satisfaction of financing condition for its conditional cash tender offer for any and all of its 7.00% senior secured notes due 2027. The offer expired May 12, 2026; US$196.4 million aggregate principal was validly tendered at a consideration of US$1,001.25 per US$1,000 principal plus accrued interest. Settlement occurred May 15, 2026. Following cancellation, US$153.6 million in notes remain outstanding and will be redeemed on June 5, 2026 at par. Deutsche Bank acted as dealer manager. This is an issuer tender offer for debt securities.
